en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al Fazl Bin ShAzaan, from Hammad Bin Isa from Rabie, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’farasws, said,
‘I said to himasws, ‘Can the man pray Salāt while he is veiled?’ So heasws said: ‘As for upon the ground, so no, and as for upon the animal, so there is no problem’.
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn ’Isma‘il has narrated from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, from Hammad ibn ‘Isa from Rib‘i, from Muhammad ibn Muslim who has said the following: “I once asked abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam,
about a man’s performing Salah (prayer) with his face veiled. He (the Imam) said, ‘It is not permissible while on the ground; however, while riding on a stumper is not an offense.’”
